what_happened: Research found two of Element 2's four automation points (milestone progress + ROADMAP regen; batch-completion-triggered systematic testing) are already live, unconditional mechanisms built by task 656 and the existing orchestrate-conclusion-roadmap.sh/orchestrate-batch-gate.sh, rather than needing new code.

Identified that git commit-tree + update-ref (never checking out the target branch) avoids the concurrent-sibling-checkout hazard that any branch-switching landing mechanism (per-task, per-invocation, or per-milestone) would otherwise reintroduce in this system's single-shared-working-tree concurrency model -- a different and more structural hazard than the squash-content-interleaving issue already named in commit-layer-cluster-ordering.md's Inputs section.

Premise re-validation found two stale carried figures: (1) the dispatch Description's ORDERING block and the research report's Recommendation both say to add edge 657->553, but edge 6 was already MOVED from 657 to 655 (commit f921c3cb5); live state.json has 657 deps [654,656] and 655 deps [513,553,654,657], and specs/decisions/commit-layer-cluster-ordering.md's Edge 6 row now names 655. The plan must NOT re-add that edge. (2) The report's flagged ROADMAP discrepancy ('657 blocked:553') no longer reproduces: ROADMAP.md now renders '657 ready' consistently with state.json.

The milestone schema already contains the exact field the Element 2 review gate needs: roadmap_milestones[].review.state's closed enum includes 'prepared' and review.ref is documented as 'Branch or ref carrying the milestone's work'. This supersedes the research report's recommendation to invent a new progress.status value, which would have violated that field's closed planned/active/closed vocabulary and forced a roadmap-format.md + state-schema.json change outside this task's file_scope.

Discovered that test-orchestrate-conclusion-roadmap.sh's 'deploy-tree-first' SUT resolution silently tests the stale deployed copy of a script when a source-store edit has not yet been redeployed, producing a misleading test failure that looks like a logic bug. Running deploy-headless.sh before re-testing resolved it (tests then passed 35/35 against the real edit). Worth remembering for any future phase that edits a script already present in the deployed tree and tests it via this resolution convention.

verify-touched.sh's scoped Phase 7 run reported test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh FAILED (specs/ tree baseline-vs-final drift) while this dispatch concurrently ran 'roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate' in the foreground during the background verify-touched.sh run -- a self-inflicted concurrency artifact, not a real regression. Re-run in isolation passed 72/0. Lesson: do not mutate specs/ in the foreground while a backgrounded verify-touched.sh/run-all.sh battery is in flight.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'specs/ROADMAP.md' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
